Resp
 Through: Ms. Meenakshi Dahiya, App for th
 State with S.I. P. Singson, P.S
 Dwarka, South.
 Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Anup Jairam Bhambhani
ORDER % 17.01.2023 Crl. M.A. No.1147/2023 (exemption) Exemption granted, subject to just exceptions.
Let requisite compliances be made within 01 week.

By way of the present petition under section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure 1973, the petitioner seeks quashing of FIR No.35/2015 dated 12.01.2015 registered under sections 498A/406 of Indian Penal Code 1860 at P.S: Dwarka South, New Delhi.
2. Though the petitioner is present in-person, respondent No.2 is not present in court today.
3. The petition is premised on mediated settlement dated 18.11.2016.

Counsel for the petitioner submits that despite having settled the matter through mediation; and despite the entire amount of settlement having been paid and the property having been transferred by the petitioner to respondent No.2 as agreed, respondent No.2 is not co- operating in having the FIR quashed.
4. Issue notice.
5.
Ms. Meenakshi Dahiya, learned APP for the State appears for the State on advance copy; and accepts notice.

6. Upon the petitioner taking steps, let notice be sent to respondent No.2, by all permissible modes,
returnable for the next date.
